answer: Coordination-Pair Settlement Levy** Each identity must anchor to a distinct physical settlement pair, logged as a dune-stable coordinate; duplicate pairings collapse into one voting unit. When two identities co-appear in a proposal above a frequency threshold, both inherit the pair's shared levy, like water pooling in a karst basin. The levy compounds per co-appearance, making a sockpuppet cluster cost more than its captured rewards—a relic of each reused pair.
